headline: Fresh Turns Mark Several Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, turnover has quickened in Marban Hollow, where seven base events were recorded in two hours, and Kuura Strand, with four. Both remain divided: Marban stands at three Warden, four Colonial and one unheld base; Kuura has five Colonial-held and one unheld. Linn Mercy logged three events in two hours and eight in six, bringing its 24-hour count to 16; its balance remains eight Colonial, two Warden and one unheld. Weathered Expanse recorded two events in the latest two hours and five in six, with five Warden, one Colonial and three unheld bases. Mooring County has two fresh events, though all 12 bases are currently Warden-held. Stlican Shelf also shows two recent events and remains nine for nine under Colonial control. Nevish Line’s 54 events over 24 hours mark heavy earlier turnover, but none occurred in the latest six. Elsewhere, intense casualty totals in Callahan’s Passage and Dead Lands come without recorded base events. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
